title: Work & Engineering Communication
sub: Incidents, delivery, reliability and code-quality words you use every day.

cards.def:
To raise an issue to a higher authority for resolution
हिंदी: मामला ऊपर के अधिकारी तक ले जाना
examples: If the vendor doesn't respond by noon, I'll escalate it to the incident manager.
The customer was unhappy, so the support agent escalated the complaint to her manager.
Please don't escalate small issues before talking to the team first.
We escalated the payment failure because it was blocking hundreds of users.

cards.def:
To fix or correct a problem, especially a vulnerability
हिंदी: सुधारना / उपचार करना
examples: The security team asked us to remediate the critical findings within a week.
The landlord promised to remediate the leaking pipe before we move in.
We have a plan to remediate the data quality issues by next sprint.
The auditor gave us thirty days to remediate the access control gaps.

cards.def:
To prioritise issues by urgency and impact
हिंदी: प्राथमिकता तय करना
examples: Let's triage the open bugs before planning the sprint.
The on-call engineer will triage new alerts every morning.
Nurses triage patients so the most serious cases are seen first.
I triage my inbox first thing and answer only the urgent mails.

cards.def:
A structured review held after an incident
हिंदी: घटना के बाद की समीक्षा
examples: We will share the postmortem with all stakeholders by Friday.
In the postmortem, we agreed not to blame any one person.
The postmortem showed that a missing config caused the outage.
Write the postmortem while the details are still fresh.

cards.def:
A tangible output promised as part of a project
हिंदी: वितरण योग्य परिणाम
examples: The main deliverable for this milestone is the migration runbook.
Please list every deliverable with its owner and due date.
The client signed off on the first deliverable this morning.
A clear deliverable helps everyone know what done looks like.

cards.def:
Responsibility and accountability for a piece of work
हिंदी: ज़िम्मेदारी लेना
examples: The team needs clearer ownership of the ingestion pipeline.
Taking ownership of a mistake builds trust with your manager.
She showed real ownership by fixing the issue over the weekend.
Who has ownership of the onboarding documents now?

cards.def:
Required to explain or justify one's actions
हिंदी: जवाबदेह
examples: Each lead is accountable for the quality of their module.
The manager is accountable for the team's delivery dates.
If I promise a date, I hold myself accountable for meeting it.
Nobody felt accountable, so the bug stayed open for months.

cards.def:
To increase speed, output or familiarity gradually
हिंदी: धीरे-धीरे गति बढ़ाना
examples: It takes about a month for new engineers to ramp up on the codebase.
We will ramp up hiring in the second half of the year.
The new joiner ramped up quickly thanks to good documentation.
Production will ramp up slowly after the factory reopens.

cards.def:
A rough estimate
हिंदी: मोटा अनुमान
examples: Can you give me a ballpark figure for the effort?
I don't need an exact cost, just a ballpark.
Ballpark, how many people will attend the offsite?
His estimate wasn't even in the right ballpark.

cards.def:
A provision for an unexpected event
हिंदी: आकस्मिक योजना
examples: We built two days of contingency into the plan.
Keep some money aside as a contingency for medical bills.
Our contingency plan is to switch to the backup vendor.
The budget includes a ten percent contingency for surprises.

cards.def:
A schedule showing when events are expected
हिंदी: समय-सीमा
examples: The vendor delay pushes our timeline by a week.
Can you share a realistic timeline for the migration?
The wedding planner gave us a timeline for the whole day.
We agreed on a tight timeline with the client.

cards.def:
To fall behind schedule
हिंदी: समय से पीछे खिसकना
examples: The release date slipped because of late security approvals.
If testing slips by two days, the launch will move too.
Don't let the small tasks slip while you focus on the big one.
Our delivery slipped twice, and the client lost patience.

cards.def:
To lower the importance of a task
हिंदी: प्राथमिकता घटाना
examples: The dashboard work was deprioritised in favour of the outage fix.
We deprioritised the redesign to focus on customer bugs.
If everything is urgent, something must be deprioritised.
I had to deprioritise my course work during the busy month.

cards.def:
To remove items from a project's scope
हिंदी: दायरा घटाना
examples: To hit the date, we had to descope the reporting module.
The client agreed to descope the mobile app from phase one.
Let's descope the nice-to-have features and ship the core first.
We descoped two reports after the budget was cut.

cards.def:
Agreement among people on goals or approach
हिंदी: सहमति / तालमेल
examples: We need alignment on the definition of done before starting.
There is strong alignment between sales and product this quarter.
Let's get alignment with the client before we write any code.
Lack of alignment between teams caused the delay.

cards.def:
A guided, step-by-step explanation
हिंदी: क्रमवार समझाना
examples: I'll record a walkthrough of the deployment process.
The trainer gave us a walkthrough of the new HR portal.
Can you do a quick walkthrough of your code before I review it?
We did a walkthrough of the flat before signing the lease.

cards.def:
A documented procedure for operating or recovering a system
हिंदी: संचालन प्रक्रिया दस्तावेज़
examples: Follow the runbook if the consumer lag keeps growing.
The new on-call engineer fixed the issue just by following the runbook.
Please update the runbook after every incident.
Without a runbook, every restart depended on one person's memory.

cards.def:
A set of established steps for handling a situation
हिंदी: कार्य-योजना की रूपरेखा
examples: We have a playbook for vendor file delays.
Sales has a playbook for handling price objections.
We followed the security playbook as soon as the breach was reported.
Every new market needs its own launch playbook.

cards.def:
A formal commitment on service levels such as response time
हिंदी: सेवा स्तर समझौता
examples: We breached the SLA for file delivery twice last month.
The SLA promises a reply to critical tickets within one hour.
Check the SLA before you promise the client a fix date.
Our new vendor offers a stronger SLA at the same price.

cards.def:
The proportion of time a system is operational
हिंदी: सिस्टम चालू रहने का समय
examples: The platform maintained 99.95 percent uptime this quarter.
Customers expect near perfect uptime from a payments app.
We track uptime on a dashboard that the whole team can see.
Better monitoring helped us improve uptime this year.

cards.def:
A period when a system is unavailable
हिंदी: सिस्टम बंद रहने का समय
examples: Planned downtime is scheduled for Sunday night.
The bank's app had two hours of downtime during the upgrade.
We moved to a new database without any downtime.
Please inform users about the downtime a day in advance.

cards.def:
A period when a service fails completely
हिंदी: सेवा का पूरी तरह बंद होना
examples: The outage lasted forty minutes and affected two vendors.
A power outage shut down the office for the afternoon.
During the outage, customers could not log in at all.
The cloud provider apologised for last night's outage.

cards.def:
A decline in performance or quality
हिंदी: प्रदर्शन में गिरावट
examples: We observed a gradual degradation in query latency.
Users noticed some degradation in video quality during peak hours.
We saw no degradation after moving to the new servers.
Slow degradation is harder to spot than a sudden failure.

cards.def:
The delay between a request and its response
हिंदी: विलंब
examples: The added hop increased latency by about 40 milliseconds.
Users in Chennai saw higher latency than users in Mumbai.
Low latency matters a lot for video calls.
We added a cache to bring the latency down.

cards.def:
The amount of work processed in a given time
हिंदी: प्रति इकाई समय में प्रसंस्कृत कार्य
examples: Batching improved throughput without raising costs.
The new machine doubled the factory's throughput.
Our team's throughput dropped when two people went on leave.
We measure throughput as tickets closed per week.

cards.def:
A point that limits overall performance
हिंदी: अवरोध बिंदु
examples: The database writes are the bottleneck, not the parsing.
Manual approval is the biggest bottleneck in our release process.
The single lift became a bottleneck at office opening time.
Adding more servers won't help if the bottleneck is the network.

cards.def:
A sudden sharp increase
हिंदी: अचानक तेज़ उछाल
examples: There was a spike in error rates right after the deploy.
We saw a spike in traffic during the festival sale.
There was a spike in calls after the new bill went out.
A sudden spike in prices worried the customers.

cards.def:
Something that deviates from what is normal
हिंदी: असामान्य विचलन
examples: The monitoring flagged an anomaly in the daily file counts.
The bank called me about an anomaly in my card spending.
One anomaly in the data can skew the whole average.
Let's investigate this anomaly before we publish the report.

cards.def:
Unreliable and inconsistently failing
हिंदी: अविश्वसनीय / कभी चलने कभी न चलने वाला
examples: That integration test is flaky and fails one run in ten.
The office Wi-Fi is so flaky that calls keep dropping.
Please fix or skip the flaky tests before the release.
A flaky build wastes everyone's time and patience.

cards.def:
Easily broken by small changes
हिंदी: नाज़ुक
examples: The parser is brittle and breaks whenever a vendor changes a header.
Tests that depend on exact timing are very brittle.
The old process is brittle and depends on one person.
We rewrote the brittle script so it handles missing fields.

cards.def:
Producing the same result however many times it runs
हिंदी: बार-बार चलाने पर भी समान परिणाम देने वाला
examples: Make the consumer idempotent so replays don't create duplicates.
A payment API must be idempotent so customers aren't charged twice.
Is this script idempotent, or will running it twice cause problems?
We made the setup step idempotent, so retries are safe.

cards.def:
Always producing the same output for the same input
हिंदी: निश्चित परिणाम देने वाला
examples: Tests should be deterministic, not dependent on timing.
Random seeds make the test results deterministic.
The build is now deterministic, so the same code gives the same output.
Pricing should be deterministic and easy to explain to customers.

cards.def:
Handling failure without abrupt breakage
हिंदी: सहज रूप से संभालने वाला
examples: We need graceful degradation when the vendor API is down.
The app shows a friendly message, a graceful way to handle errors.
We need a graceful shutdown so no orders are lost.
Graceful handling of timeouts keeps users from seeing a blank screen.

cards.def:
Working with earlier versions without breaking
हिंदी: पुराने संस्करणों के साथ भी चलने वाला
examples: The new schema must remain backward compatible with existing consumers.
Is the new app version backward compatible with old phones?
Keep the API backward compatible so mobile users aren't affected.
The update wasn't backward compatible, so old reports stopped loading.

cards.def:
To mark something as obsolete and discourage its use
हिंदी: अप्रचलित घोषित करना
examples: We will deprecate the v1 endpoint at the end of the year.
The company plans to deprecate the old desktop app next year.
Once we deprecate a feature, we stop adding fixes to it.
Please tell users clearly before you deprecate any setting.

cards.def:
To retire a system from service
हिंदी: सेवा से हटाना
examples: The legacy batch job was finally decommissioned.
We will decommission the old servers after the data is moved.
The plant was decommissioned after forty years of use.
Before we decommission the tool, let's export the old records.

cards.def:
Future cost of choosing a quick solution now
हिंदी: तकनीकी उधार
examples: We are paying interest on technical debt every sprint.
Rushing the release left us with a lot of technical debt.
We spend one day each sprint paying down technical debt.
Technical debt makes even small changes slow and risky.

cards.def:
Repetitive standard code written again and again
हिंदी: दोहराया जाने वाला मानक कोड
examples: Annotations removed most of the boilerplate.
The template gives you the boilerplate, so you only write the logic.
Most of the contract is boilerplate, but read the payment terms carefully.
I wrote a script to generate the boilerplate for new services.

cards.def:
Hiding complexity behind a simpler interface
हिंदी: जटिलता छुपाकर सरल रूप देना
examples: This abstraction leaks implementation details to callers.
A good abstraction lets new developers work without knowing every detail.
We added an abstraction over the payment providers.
Too much abstraction can make simple code hard to follow.

cards.def:
To enclose details within a single unit or module
हिंदी: विवरण को एक इकाई में समेटना
examples: Encapsulate the vendor-specific logic behind one interface.
Encapsulate the database calls in one class so they're easy to change.
The report tries to encapsulate a year of work in one page.
We encapsulated the retry logic in a small helper.

cards.def:
To reduce the dependence between components
हिंदी: आपसी निर्भरता घटाना
examples: Using events lets us decouple ingestion from reporting.
A message queue helps decouple the order service from billing.
We decoupled the release schedule from the marketing calendar.
Decouple the UI from the backend so each can change independently.

cards.def:
Built from independent, interchangeable parts
हिंदी: मॉड्यूल आधारित
examples: A modular design makes vendor onboarding faster.
The modular kitchen lets us change the cabinets easily.
Our training course is modular, so people can pick the topics they need.
A modular codebase lets teams work without blocking each other.

cards.def:
Easy to update and fix over time
हिंदी: आसानी से रखरखाव योग्य
examples: Readable names make the code more maintainable.
Small functions with clear names are more maintainable.
We want a solution that is simple and maintainable, not clever.
The old system worked, but it wasn't maintainable anymore.

cards.def:
Designed to be easily extended with new features
हिंदी: आसानी से बढ़ाने योग्य
examples: An extensible rule engine saves us rework later.
The form builder is extensible, so we can add new field types easily.
Plugins make the editor highly extensible.
Design the config to be extensible for future countries.

cards.def:
The ability to understand a system's state from its outputs
हिंदी: प्रणाली की स्थिति समझने की क्षमता
examples: Better observability would have shortened this incident.
Good observability helps us find problems before customers do.
We invested in observability after a long night of guessing.
Logs, metrics and traces are the basics of observability.

cards.def:
Automatically collected data about system behaviour
हिंदी: प्रणाली से स्वचालित रूप से एकत्र डेटा
examples: We emit telemetry on every file processed.
The app sends telemetry only if the user agrees.
Telemetry showed that most users never open the settings page.
Car makers use telemetry to track engine health.

cards.def:
To add monitoring or measurement to code
हिंदी: निगरानी जोड़ना
examples: Let's instrument the retry path so we can see how often it fires.
We instrumented the checkout flow to see where users drop off.
Instrument the slow API before you try to optimise it.
The library makes it easy to instrument every request.

cards.def:
Automated notification when metrics cross thresholds
हिंदी: चेतावनी सूचना व्यवस्था
examples: Our alerting is too noisy to be useful.
Set up alerting so the team knows when payments fail.
Good alerting wakes you up only for real problems.
We reviewed our alerting rules after missing an incident.

cards.def:
A limit at which something changes or triggers
हिंदी: सीमा-स्तर
examples: The alert fires when lag crosses the threshold for five minutes.
Your account is flagged if spending crosses a certain threshold.
We lowered the threshold so alerts fire earlier.
Tax applies only above an income threshold.

cards.def:
A reference measurement used for comparison
हिंदी: तुलना हेतु आधार स्तर
examples: We need a baseline before we can claim an improvement.
Measure the page load time today so we have a baseline.
Compared to the baseline, error rates fell by half.
The doctor took a baseline reading before starting the medicine.

cards.def:
Analysing where a program spends time or memory
हिंदी: कोड के समय/मेमोरी उपयोग का विश्लेषण
examples: Profiling revealed that serialisation was the hot spot.
Let's do some profiling before we guess why the app is slow.
Memory profiling showed that images were never released.
The profiling report pointed to one slow database call.

cards.def:
To make something as efficient as possible
हिंदी: अनुकूलित करना
examples: Optimise the query only after measuring it.
We optimised the images so the page loads twice as fast.
Try to optimise your daily schedule around your most focused hours.
The delivery company optimised its routes to save fuel.

cards.def:
Optimising before knowing it is necessary
हिंदी: समय से पहले अनुकूलन
examples: Caching everything now would be premature optimisation.
Writing custom code for a hundred users is premature optimisation.
He spent a week on premature optimisation instead of shipping the feature.
Avoid premature optimisation; first make it work, then make it fast.

cards.def:
A limitation that restricts options
हिंदी: बाध्यता
examples: Our main constraint is the vendor's rate limit.
Time is our biggest constraint on this project.
Budget constraints mean we can't hire this year.
Work within the constraints you have instead of waiting for perfect ones.

cards.def:
Something accepted as true without proof
हिंदी: मान्यता
examples: Let's validate that assumption before committing.
My assumption was that the client wanted a mobile app first.
Write down every assumption in the project plan.
The estimate was based on a wrong assumption about data size.

cards.def:
To check that something is correct or acceptable
हिंदी: सत्यापित करना
examples: We validate each file against the schema on arrival.
The form validates the phone number before you can submit it.
Talk to five customers to validate the idea before building it.
We validated the new process with a small pilot team.

cards.def:
To confirm that something is true
हिंदी: पुष्टि करना
examples: Please verify the numbers before sending the report.
Please verify your email address to activate the account.
The bank called to verify a large transaction on my card.
I verified the fix on staging before closing the ticket.

cards.def:
To make two sets of data or accounts agree
हिंदी: मिलान करना
examples: We reconcile the vendor totals with our own counts every night.
I reconcile my bank statement with my expenses every month.
Finance couldn't reconcile the invoice with the purchase order.
We need a script to reconcile orders between the two systems.

cards.def:
A difference between things that should match
हिंदी: असंगति / अंतर
examples: There's a discrepancy between the two price feeds.
The auditor found a discrepancy in the travel claims.
There's a discrepancy between the stock count and the system.
Please explain the discrepancy before we close the books.

cards.def:
A lack of agreement or uniformity
हिंदी: असंगति
examples: The inconsistency in date formats caused the failures.
Customers noticed the inconsistency between the app and the website prices.
Inconsistency in naming makes the code hard to read.
His story had one small inconsistency that the manager noticed.

cards.def:
Uncertainty because something can be read in more than one way
हिंदी: अस्पष्टता
examples: The ticket's ambiguity led to two different implementations.
To avoid ambiguity, please write the exact date and time.
The contract had some ambiguity about who pays for travel.
Ask questions early to clear up any ambiguity in the requirements.

cards.def:
To express an idea clearly and effectively
हिंदी: स्पष्ट रूप से व्यक्त करना
examples: She articulated the risks without sounding alarmist.
He found it hard to articulate why he wanted to change teams.
A good leader can articulate the vision in a few simple words.
Practise articulating your achievements before the appraisal meeting.

cards.def:
Brief but comprehensive
हिंदी: संक्षिप्त और सारगर्भित
examples: Keep the update concise and lead with the impact.
Your answer was concise and to the point.
Write concise commit messages that explain the why.
Senior leaders prefer concise emails with a clear ask.

cards.def:
Briefly and clearly expressed
हिंदी: संक्षेप में कहा गया
examples: Her succinct summary saved the meeting ten minutes.
Give a succinct answer when the interviewer asks about yourself.
The poster had a succinct message that everyone remembered.
His succinct reply was just: done, deployed, monitoring.

cards.def:
Complete and covering all aspects
हिंदी: व्यापक
examples: We wrote comprehensive documentation for the new service.
The insurance plan offers comprehensive cover for the whole family.
She gave a comprehensive overview of the market in twenty minutes.
We need a comprehensive test plan before the launch.

cards.def:
Careful and complete
हिंदी: गहन / संपूर्ण
examples: He did a thorough review and caught three edge cases.
The doctor was thorough and asked about my whole medical history.
Be thorough when you check the contract terms.
Thanks for the thorough feedback on my design document.

cards.def:
Strict and carefully precise
हिंदी: कठोर और सटीक
examples: We apply a rigorous review process to every change.
The selection process is rigorous, with three rounds of interviews.
Rigorous testing gave us confidence in the release.
Her research is rigorous and well documented.

cards.def:
Practical rather than idealistic
हिंदी: व्यावहारिक
examples: A pragmatic fix now is better than a perfect one next quarter.
Let's be pragmatic and fix the top three issues first.
My manager takes a pragmatic approach to deadlines.
A pragmatic choice was to buy the tool instead of building it.

cards.def:
Thorough investigation before a decision or agreement
हिंदी: निर्णय से पहले की गहन जाँच
examples: Please do your due diligence before adopting the library.
Do your due diligence before investing in any startup.
The buyer's lawyers did due diligence on the property papers.
Due diligence on the vendor revealed some security gaps.

cards.def:
Acting in advance to deal with expected issues
हिंदी: पहले से सक्रिय रहने वाला
examples: Being proactive with vendors avoided another late-file incident.
She was proactive and booked the meeting room in advance.
Be proactive and tell your manager about risks early.
A proactive health check-up can catch problems early.

cards.def:
Responding only after a problem occurs
हिंदी: घटना के बाद प्रतिक्रिया देने वाला
examples: Our support has been too reactive and needs better monitoring.
We want to stop being reactive and plan our work properly.
Reactive maintenance costs more than regular servicing.
His style is reactive; he waits until the client complains.

cards.def:
To make things conform to a common standard
हिंदी: मानकीकृत करना
examples: We need to standardise how errors are logged.
The company standardised laptops for all new joiners.
Let's standardise the format of our weekly reports.
Standardising the process cut onboarding time by half.

cards.def:
To combine several things into one
हिंदी: एकीकृत करना
examples: We consolidated three similar jobs into one.
I consolidated my three loans into one with a lower interest rate.
We consolidated all the feedback into a single document.
The company plans to consolidate its two offices in Pune.

cards.def:
To use something to maximum advantage
हिंदी: का भरपूर लाभ उठाना
examples: We can leverage the existing validation library.
Leverage your network when you look for a new job.
We can leverage our existing customers to test the new product.
She leveraged her data skills to move into analytics.

cards.def:
To make practical use of something
हिंदी: उपयोग में लाना
examples: The team utilises serverless functions for lightweight tasks.
The hospital utilises every bed during the flu season.
We should utilise the training budget before March.
The new tool is not being utilised by most teams.

cards.def:
To make an action or process easier
हिंदी: सुविधाजनक बनाना
examples: The new tool facilitates faster vendor onboarding.
The HR team will facilitate the workshop on Friday.
Good documentation facilitates faster code reviews.
The new metro line facilitates travel between the two cities.

cards.def:
To speed up the progress of something
हिंदी: तेज़ी से निपटाना
examples: Can we expedite the approval given the deadline?
The passport office can expedite your application for an extra fee.
Please expedite the shipment; the customer is waiting.
We expedited the hiring because the project started early.

cards.def:
Efficient and free of unnecessary steps
हिंदी: सुव्यवस्थित
examples: The streamlined deploy process takes five minutes.
The bank now has a streamlined process for opening accounts online.
A streamlined checkout means fewer abandoned carts.
After the changes, our onboarding is much more streamlined.

cards.def:
The time taken to complete a task after receiving it
हिंदी: कार्य पूरा होने में लगा समय
examples: Our turnaround on support tickets is under a day.
The print shop offers a same-day turnaround on business cards.
What is the usual turnaround for a code review here?
Fast turnaround on feedback keeps the project moving.

cards.def:
The ability to track an item through its lifecycle
हिंदी: ट्रैक करने की क्षमता
examples: Audit requirements demand full traceability of each file.
Traceability lets us link every test to a requirement.
Food companies need traceability to track where ingredients came from.
The new system improves traceability of every order.

cards.def:
A chronological record of actions for review
हिंदी: कार्यों का क्रमवार रिकॉर्ड
examples: Every manual change must leave an audit trail.
The audit trail shows who approved the payment and when.
Use the ticket system so there's an audit trail of decisions.
Without an audit trail, we couldn't prove the data wasn't changed.

cards.def:
Formal approval to proceed
हिंदी: औपचारिक स्वीकृति
examples: We still need sign-off from the risk team.
The design is ready, but we're waiting for the client's sign-off.
Get sign-off from your manager before you book the travel.
Final sign-off on the budget came on Friday evening.

cards.def:
Reverting a system to a previous state
हिंदी: पिछली स्थिति में लौटाना
examples: We triggered a rollback within ten minutes of the alert.
Always have a rollback plan before a production release.
The rollback was smooth, and users noticed nothing.
We practised a rollback in staging before the big deploy.

cards.def:
The moment of switching from an old system to a new one
हिंदी: पुराने से नए सिस्टम में बदलाव का क्षण
examples: The cutover is planned for the weekend.
During the cutover, the old system will be read-only.
The bank's cutover to the new core system went smoothly.
We rehearsed the cutover twice before the real night.

cards.def:
Releasing to a small group first to detect problems
हिंदी: पहले छोटे समूह में रिलीज़
examples: A canary release exposed the memory leak early.
We did a canary release to five percent of users first.
The canary release showed no errors, so we rolled out to everyone.
A canary release limits the damage if something goes wrong.

cards.def:
A switch that enables or disables a feature without redeploying
हिंदी: फ़ीचर चालू/बंद करने वाला स्विच
examples: Put the change behind a feature flag so we can disable it quickly.
We turned on the feature flag for internal users only.
Remove old feature flags once the feature is fully launched.
With a feature flag, marketing can launch the feature on their own schedule.

cards.def:
The state of being equal or equivalent
हिंदी: समानता
examples: Staging should have parity with production.
Women demand pay parity with men in the same role.
The mobile app has reached feature parity with the website.
Keep test data in parity with real customer patterns.

cards.def:
Gradual divergence from an intended state
हिंदी: धीरे-धीरे भटकाव
examples: Configuration drift caused the environments to behave differently.
Over time, there was drift between the documentation and the code.
We run a weekly check to detect infrastructure drift.
Without regular reviews, project goals tend to drift.

cards.def:
To set up and make resources available
हिंदी: संसाधन उपलब्ध कराना
examples: Terraform provisions the entire environment in minutes.
IT will provision your laptop and email before you join.
It takes minutes to provision a new database in the cloud.
Please provision access for the new contractors by Monday.

cards.def:
To coordinate multiple components or tasks
हिंदी: कई घटकों का समन्वय करना
examples: Step Functions orchestrate the whole ingestion workflow.
She orchestrated the whole product launch across five teams.
Kubernetes orchestrates containers across many machines.
The event manager orchestrated the conference smoothly.

cards.def:
To take in data for processing
हिंदी: डेटा ग्रहण करना
examples: The platform ingests over a thousand files every day.
The system can ingest data from emails and spreadsheets.
We ingest logs from all servers into one search tool.
If we can't ingest the file, we send the vendor an alert.

cards.def:
To spread or transmit through a system
हिंदी: फैलना / आगे पहुँचना
examples: The change takes a few minutes to propagate to all regions.
DNS changes can take a few hours to propagate.
Errors in one service can propagate and break others.
The news propagated quickly through the office chat groups.

cards.def:
To deliberately limit the rate of requests
हिंदी: गति सीमित करना
examples: The API throttles us after one hundred requests per minute.
We throttle login attempts to stop password guessing.
The ISP throttled my internet speed after I crossed the limit.
Throttle the batch job so it doesn't slow down the live site.

cards.def:
A strategy of waiting longer between retries
हिंदी: पुनः प्रयास में बढ़ता अंतराल
examples: Use exponential backoff to avoid overloading the vendor.
Add a backoff so the client waits longer after each failure.
Without backoff, retries can make an outage worse.
The backoff starts at one second and doubles each time.

cards.def:
Automatic switch to a standby system on failure
हिंदी: विफलता पर स्टैंडबाय पर स्विच
examples: Failover to the secondary region took about two minutes.
We test failover every quarter to make sure it works.
The database failover happened automatically at 3 am.
Failover kept the website running when one data centre went down.

cards.def:
Duplicate components that provide backup
हिंदी: अतिरिक्त बैकअप व्यवस्था
examples: Redundancy at the queue level protects against data loss.
The office has redundancy with two internet connections.
Hospitals build redundancy into their power supply.
Redundancy costs money, but it saves us during outages.

cards.def:
A system's ability to continue despite failures
हिंदी: दोष सहनशीलता
examples: Kafka gives us strong fault tolerance for event delivery.
Fault tolerance means one server failure won't stop the service.
We tested fault tolerance by switching off random machines.
Aircraft systems are designed with high fault tolerance.

cards.def:
A component whose failure stops the whole system
हिंदी: एकल विफलता बिंदु
examples: The shared config server is a single point of failure.
If only one person knows the system, they are a single point of failure.
The one router in the office is a single point of failure.
We removed every single point of failure before the big sale.

cards.def:
A bug caused by the timing of concurrent operations
हिंदी: समयबद्धता पर निर्भर बग
examples: The duplicate rows came from a race condition between two consumers.
A race condition let two users book the same seat.
The bug appeared only under load, a classic race condition.
Use a lock to prevent a race condition when updating the balance.

cards.def:
A situation where processes wait on each other forever
हिंदी: आपसी प्रतीक्षा में अटकना
examples: Two transactions caused a deadlock in the database.
The app froze because of a deadlock between two threads.
Talks reached a deadlock when neither side would compromise.
Always take locks in the same order to avoid a deadlock.

cards.def:
Multiple tasks making progress at overlapping times
हिंदी: समवर्तिता
examples: Concurrency bugs are hard to reproduce.
The new web server handles high concurrency without slowing down.
We limited concurrency to ten jobs so the database stays healthy.
Concurrency lets the app download images while the user keeps scrolling.

cards.def:
Not happening at the same time or in sequence
हिंदी: अतुल्यकालिक
examples: We process files asynchronously to keep the API responsive.
Our team works asynchronously across three time zones.
Send an asynchronous update in the channel instead of calling a meeting.
The upload is asynchronous, so you can close the page.

cards.def:
The actual data carried in a message or request
हिंदी: संदेश का मुख्य डेटा
examples: The payload exceeded the size limit of the queue.
Keep the payload small so the mobile app loads quickly.
The webhook payload includes the order id and status.
Log the payload when a request fails, but hide personal data.

cards.def:
The defined structure of data
हिंदी: डेटा की संरचना
examples: The vendor changed the schema without notice.
Please share the database schema before we start the report.
A clear schema makes the data easy for other teams to use.
We added two optional fields to the schema.

cards.def:
Checking incoming data for correctness
हिंदी: आने वाले डेटा की जाँच
examples: Payload validation rejects malformed files early.
Payload validation caught a request with a negative price.
Without payload validation, bad data reached the database.
We return a clear error message when payload validation fails.

cards.def:
An unusual situation at the extreme of normal operation
हिंदी: असामान्य सीमांत स्थिति
examples: Leap-year dates were an edge case we missed.
What happens if the user has no middle name? That's an edge case.
Test the edge cases, like zero items and very large orders.
A good tester always thinks about edge cases.

cards.def:
A rare situation involving multiple extreme conditions together
हिंदी: दुर्लभ जटिल स्थिति
examples: The bug only appears in a corner case with empty files and retries.
The crash was a corner case: offline mode, low battery and a big file.
We found a corner case where two discounts applied together.
Don't block the release for a corner case that affects one user.

cards.def:
Able to be recreated consistently
हिंदी: दोहराने योग्य
examples: The bug is reproducible with this sample file.
Please share reproducible steps so we can fix the bug.
The error is not reproducible on my laptop.
Good science needs results that are reproducible by others.

cards.def:
Occurring at irregular intervals
हिंदी: रुक-रुक कर होने वाला
examples: The intermittent timeout is hard to diagnose.
My phone has an intermittent charging problem.
The intermittent error happens maybe twice a week.
Intermittent network issues made the video call choppy.

cards.def:
Occurring occasionally and unpredictably
हिंदी: यदा-कदा होने वाला
examples: We saw sporadic failures during peak hours.
We get sporadic complaints about late deliveries.
There was sporadic rain throughout the day.
His attendance at the weekly meeting has been sporadic.

cards.def:
Continuing without stopping
हिंदी: लगातार बना रहने वाला
examples: A persistent error indicates a configuration problem.
She had a persistent cough for three weeks.
The persistent noise from construction made it hard to focus.
Persistent follow-ups finally got the vendor to respond.

cards.def:
To identify exactly the cause or location
हिंदी: ठीक-ठीक पहचानना
examples: The logs helped us pinpoint the failing step.
Can you pinpoint when the problem first started?
The mechanic pinpointed the noise to a loose belt.
It's hard to pinpoint one reason for the drop in sales.

cards.def:
To separate something to study it independently
हिंदी: अलग करके जाँचना
examples: First, isolate the component that's producing bad output.
Isolate the patient to stop the infection from spreading.
We isolated the slow query by turning off features one by one.
Try to isolate the issue to a single file before asking for help.

cards.def:
To confirm with additional evidence
हिंदी: अतिरिक्त प्रमाण से पुष्टि करना
examples: The metrics corroborate what the customers reported.
Two other witnesses corroborated her story.
Sales data corroborates the customer survey results.
Can anyone corroborate that the server was restarted at noon?

cards.def:
To provide evidence supporting a claim
हिंदी: प्रमाण देकर सिद्ध करना
examples: Can you substantiate that estimate with historical data?
You'll need receipts to substantiate your expense claim.
He couldn't substantiate his claim that the vendor was at fault.
Substantiate your feedback with specific examples.

cards.def:
A warning or condition that qualifies a statement
हिंदी: चेतावनी / शर्त
examples: One caveat is that this only works for files under 1 GB.
The offer sounds great, but there's a caveat: it's only for new users.
I'll agree, with one caveat: we review it after a month.
Please add a caveat that these numbers are not final.

cards.def:
A statement limiting responsibility or certainty
हिंदी: अस्वीकरण
examples: A quick disclaimer: this is based on partial data.
The advert had a small disclaimer about hidden charges.
The video starts with a disclaimer that it is not financial advice.
I'll start with a disclaimer: I'm not an expert in tax.

cards.def:
A subtle difference in meaning or detail
हिंदी: सूक्ष्म अंतर
examples: There's a nuance in how vendors define a corrected price.
Learning a language means understanding its nuances.
The nuance in his feedback was that the idea is good but early.
A good translator captures every nuance of the original.

cards.def:
A likely consequence or effect
हिंदी: निहितार्थ
examples: What are the implications for downstream reports?
Have you thought about the cost implications of this plan?
The implication of his comment was that we were too slow.
The new law has big implications for small businesses.

cards.def:
A complicating consequence of an action
हिंदी: जटिल परिणाम
examples: The ramifications of changing the key are significant.
The merger had ramifications for every department.
Consider the legal ramifications before you sign.
Nobody expected the ramifications of that small pricing change.

cards.def:
An unintended consequence, usually negative
हिंदी: दुष्परिणाम
examples: Skipping validation had serious repercussions.
Missing the deadline could have repercussions for your appraisal.
The repercussions of the data leak are still being felt.
He spoke honestly, without fear of repercussions.

cards.def:
Action taken to reduce harm or risk
हिंदी: जोखिम घटाने की कार्रवाई
examples: The mitigation plan includes automatic retries.
Wearing a helmet is a simple mitigation against head injury.
List each risk along with its mitigation in the plan.
Our mitigation for vendor delays is a backup supplier.

cards.def:
A plan for use if something goes wrong
हिंदी: आपात योजना
examples: We need a contingency plan if the vendor misses the deadline.
If it rains, our contingency plan is to move the party indoors.
Every big launch needs a contingency plan.
Our contingency plan for the outage was a manual process.

cards.def:
An alternative to use if the main option fails
हिंदी: विकल्प / वैकल्पिक व्यवस्था
examples: The fallback is to load yesterday's file.
If the card payment fails, cash on delivery is the fallback.
My fallback option is to take the train if the flight is cancelled.
Always have a fallback when you depend on one supplier.

cards.def:
A measure that protects against harm
हिंदी: सुरक्षा उपाय
examples: Validation acts as a safeguard against corrupt data.
Two-step verification is a safeguard for your bank account.
The law includes safeguards to protect workers.
We added a safeguard so nobody can delete data by mistake.

cards.def:
A hidden danger or common mistake
हिंदी: छुपा हुआ ख़तरा
examples: A common pitfall is ignoring time zones.
One pitfall of working from home is never switching off.
The guide lists common pitfalls for first-time home buyers.
Avoid the pitfall of promising dates before you understand the work.

cards.def:
An unexpected catch or hidden difficulty
हिंदी: अनपेक्षित अड़चन
examples: Here's a gotcha: the vendor timestamps are in local time.
The gotcha with this phone plan is the high roaming charge.
One gotcha in this library is that dates are zero-indexed by month.
Read the fine print; there's always a gotcha.

cards.def:
End of day
हिंदी: दिन का अंत
examples: I'll send the summary by EOD.
Please share the draft by EOD tomorrow.
Can I get back to you by EOD?
EOD in India is early morning for our US clients.

cards.def:
A very short summary of a long text
हिंदी: संक्षेप में
examples: TL;DR, we need two more weeks to finish safely.
TL;DR: the launch is on track, with one small risk.
Add a TL;DR at the top of long emails.
Here is the TL;DR of the hour-long meeting.

cards.def:
A point of contact or interaction
हिंदी: संपर्क बिंदु
examples: We have a weekly touchpoint with the vendor.
The app is our main touchpoint with customers.
Every touchpoint should give the customer the same experience.
Let's set up a short daily touchpoint during the release week.

cards.def:
A regular rhythm or frequency of events
हिंदी: नियमित अंतराल / लय
examples: Let's set a fortnightly cadence for reviews.
We release to production on a weekly cadence.
The team found a good cadence after a few sprints.
Monthly one-on-ones are a good cadence for most people.

cards.def:
A team meeting to reflect on what went well and what didn't
हिंदी: कार्य-समीक्षा बैठक
examples: The retrospective surfaced the same communication gaps.
In the retrospective, we agreed to write smaller tickets.
Keep the retrospective safe so people speak honestly.
Each retrospective should end with two or three action items.

cards.def:
A key lesson or point to remember
हिंदी: मुख्य निष्कर्ष
examples: My main takeaway is that we need earlier testing.
The key takeaway from the training was to listen more.
Please share your takeaways from the conference with the team.
One takeaway from the incident was to test backups regularly.

cards.def:
A place to note off-topic items for later discussion
हिंदी: बाद में चर्चा के लिए रखे गए विषय
examples: Let's put that in the parking lot and return to it later.
I've added your budget question to the parking lot.
We ran out of time, so the parking lot items move to Friday.
Use a parking lot to keep the meeting on track.

cards.def:
An in-depth examination of a topic
हिंदी: गहन अध्ययन
examples: We scheduled a deep dive into the retry logic.
Let's do a deep dive into why customers cancel their orders.
The training ended with a deep dive on security basics.
I need a deep dive into the numbers before I approve the budget.

cards.def:
Explaining ideas visually on a board
हिंदी: बोर्ड पर चित्र बनाकर समझाना
examples: The whiteboarding session clarified the data flow.
We spent an hour whiteboarding the new user journey.
Whiteboarding works well for explaining complex systems.
In the interview, they asked me to do some whiteboarding.

cards.def:
A rehearsal without real effects
हिंदी: बिना असर वाला अभ्यास
examples: Do a dry run of the migration first.
Let's do a dry run of the presentation before the client call.
The dry run showed that the script missed two tables.
We did a dry run of the fire drill last week.

cards.def:
The degree to which something can be done
हिंदी: व्यवहार्यता
examples: We are assessing the feasibility of real-time ingestion.
The study looked at the feasibility of a new metro line.
Before we promise anything, let's check the feasibility.
A short feasibility test showed the idea could work.

cards.def:
The ability to work successfully
हिंदी: व्यवहार्यता / टिकाऊपन
examples: The pilot confirmed the viability of the approach.
Investors questioned the long-term viability of the business.
The survey helped us judge the viability of the new product.
Rising costs threaten the viability of small restaurants.

cards.def:
Agreed criteria for a task to be considered finished
हिंदी: कार्य पूर्ण मानने के मानदंड
examples: Tests and documentation are part of our definition of done.
Code review is part of our definition of done.
Agree on a definition of done before the sprint starts.
The ticket isn't closed until it meets the definition of done.

cards.def:
Conditions a feature must meet to be accepted
हिंदी: स्वीकृति की शर्तें
examples: Write clear acceptance criteria before development starts.
The tester checked every acceptance criteria item before approving.
Vague acceptance criteria lead to arguments at the demo.
Please add acceptance criteria to the story before planning.

cards.def:
A chart showing remaining work over time
हिंदी: शेष कार्य दर्शाने वाला चार्ट
examples: The burndown shows we're behind schedule.
The burndown dropped sharply after we closed the big tickets.
Check the burndown chart in the daily stand-up.
A flat burndown means work is stuck somewhere.

cards.def:
Reviewing and refining backlog items before planning
हिंदी: बैकलॉग की समीक्षा व परिष्कार
examples: Backlog grooming clarified the vague tickets.
We do backlog grooming every Wednesday afternoon.
After grooming, each ticket had a clear estimate.
Skipping grooming made our sprint planning very long.

cards.def:
To criticise minor details excessively
हिंदी: छोटी बातों पर टोकना
examples: I don't want to nitpick, but the variable name is unclear.
My manager tends to nitpick every slide I make.
Please don't nitpick spacing; focus on the logic in the review.
One small nitpick: there's a typo in the subject line.

cards.def:
A clash between changes made to the same code
हिंदी: कोड बदलावों का टकराव
examples: I'll resolve the merge conflict before lunch.
Small, frequent commits reduce the chance of a merge conflict.
The merge conflict happened because we both edited the same file.
Ask the other developer before resolving a tricky merge conflict.

cards.def:
To reapply commits on top of another base
हिंदी: कमिट्स को नए आधार पर दोबारा लगाना
examples: Please rebase your branch on the latest main.
I rebased my changes so the history stays clean.
Don't rebase a branch that others are already using.
After the rebase, all the tests passed again.

cards.def:
Available to respond to urgent issues outside work hours
हिंदी: आपात स्थिति के लिए उपलब्ध
examples: I'm on-call this weekend.
The on-call engineer got paged at 2 am.
We rotate on-call duty every week.
Being on-call means keeping your laptop close.

cards.def:
The person leading the response to an incident
हिंदी: घटना संभालने वाला नेतृत्वकर्ता
examples: The incident commander assigned roles within minutes.
The incident commander decides when to roll back.
She was the incident commander during the payment outage.
The incident commander sends updates every thirty minutes.

cards.def:
A dedicated space or channel for handling a crisis
हिंदी: संकट संभालने का विशेष कक्ष
examples: We opened a war room for the production outage.
The war room had people from engineering, support and legal.
We set up a war room for the big sale weekend.
The war room closed once the system was stable again.
